resources.string: FileApex uses Accessibility to detect copy events so clipboard can sync while the app is in the background. FileApex does not read screen content for any other purpose.
Expandable 1 to 4 customizable FileApex actions bound to a device, all online devices, or ask each time.
Paired device card with online status, cached battery pill, tap-to-browse, and on-demand refresh.
One-tap file picker to send files directly to a chosen device or all online devices.
Live Bulletin Board notes and interactive checklists with quick post.
